findings.detail: Lines 104-129 are ~26 lines of comment for the 12-line live region that follows. The middle block (108-116) is the rationale for the PREVIOUS shape — a hidden `sr-only` region holding a copy of the status text — and its "Two corrections to the first attempt" narration no longer matches the code below it, which the newly added block (117-129) then re-explains with a different pair of corrections. A reader has to diff two competing explanations against the JSX to work out which one is live. This is comment cruft accumulating a review changelog in-tree, where git history already holds it; it is not a behavioural defect, which is why it is low. It would rise to medium if a future change followed the stale block's advice (keep the region hidden, announce only the badge) and silently reintroduced the unannounced-remediation bug this PR fixes.
findings.summary: Three stacked comment blocks narrate superseded designs above one element
